about: The `report_anomalies` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is fy 2012 only.

rows.table: Abstract of assessments by property class
rows.detail: As in FY2011, most account counts are missing from the OCR — only Mixed Use (40), Three Family (7) and Apartments (7) print a count — while every valuation and average value is present, so counts can be recovered by division.

rows.table: 2012 state ballot questions with vote by precinct
rows.detail: Question 1 (right to repair) and Question 3 have their explanatory text but their vote tables are missing from the OCR.

rows.table: Library statistics for 2012
rows.detail: NEW — the equivalent block in FY2011 is missing from the OCR entirely. 5th highest per capita appropriation among 12 similar-sized towns at $33.63 per capita; 70% of residents registered; open 2,178 hours; close to 200 programmes; over 2,000 volunteer hours; 70,218 volumes of which 46,789 books; over 21,982 interlibrary loans; circulation 116,429 items, 78,230 books and 25,131 videos.

rows.table: General fund revenues pie chart, FY12
rows.detail: The property tax slice is absent.

rows.table: Special revenue funds: grants, gifts and revolving accounts, FY2012
rows.detail: The table heading and column headers are still absent (p66 starts mid-list at 'Regional Assessor Fund'), but the GRAND TOTAL is present and the opening balances tie exactly to FY2011's closing balances ($2,766,954.67 in both), which is a real cross-year check.
The New Growth Revenue table stops at FY2011: the FY2012 report reprints the FY2011 table without adding its own year. There is no published FY2012 new growth figure in this document.
The p17 communicable disease table is PRINTED TWICE on the same page with identical disease counts but a different Skilled Nursing figure (28 in one copy, 14 in the other).

rows.table: New growth revenue by fiscal year, FY2004-FY2011
rows.detail: The table STOPS AT FY2011 — the FY2012 report reprints the FY2011 report's table unchanged rather than adding a FY2012 row.

rows.table: FY 2012 receipts, line by line
rows.detail: Key figures: REAL ESTATE TAXES $18,071,378.17, MOTOR VEHICLE EXCISE $1,286,412.15, CH 70 SCHOOL AID $4,612,665.00 (up from $4,523,464 in FY2011), LOTTERY/BEANO $829,777.00 (DOWN from $894,449), MSBA REIMB-SCHOOL $499,098.00 (identical to FY2011), ICE STORM/FLOODING REIMBURSEMENT $142,196.00, BUILDING PERMITS $96,279.50 (down from $181,516.40).

The Abstract of Assessments on p10 is headed 'Fiscal Year 2011' but contains FY2012 figures — its TOTALS row is 1,120,966,561, which the valuation history two lines above identifies as FY2012. A heading-based search would pull the wrong year.
Two reports give different 2010 US Census populations for Lunenburg: 10,085 in FY2011 and 10,280 in FY2012, both attributed to the same census.
The capital plan table on p12 has its columns in a different order from its own header: the header reads DEPARTMENT / ITEM / AMOUNT and the rows read department, amount, item.

The Proposition 2½ override — $2,200,000, defeated 1084 to 2275 — is fully documented in three places that can be joined: the Finance Committee's account of what was cut (p20), the line-by-line contingent appropriation in Article 9 (p83), and the precinct-level ballot result (p105). The override budget and the budget that actually passed share line numbers, so the counterfactual is directly comparable.

The district published its out-of-district special education placement COUNT on p33 — 24 students, 19 day and 5 residential, 7 of the day placements in a Collaborative. That is the number the project's standing questions list as unpublished.

The FY2013 omnibus budget of $27,489,441 includes nearly $900,000 transferred from sewer betterment, water betterment, sewer enterprise and septic receipts — the article text says so and the budget table does not.

The FY2011 and FY2010 columns of the exemptions/abatements table DISAGREE with the same columns as printed in the FY2011 report — 'Amount Released' FY2011 is 4,385.99 here and 119,992.49 there. Prior years are restated between reports.

rows.detail: The FY2011 and FY2010 columns here DISAGREE with the same columns in the FY2011 report: 'Charges to 6/30/2010' FY2010 reads 116,250.15 here and 112,378.97 there; 'Amount Released' FY2011 reads 4,385.99 here and 119,992.49 there.
Total long-term indebtedness for FY2009 is printed as $29,490,706 here and $22,490,706 in the FY2011 report. One is a transposition and the tables do not agree.
